name: How do I choose a contractor for structural remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for structural remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a contractor for structural remodeling requires careful consideration. Look for a licensed and insured general contractor with a proven track record specifically in structural work. Verify their experience, check references, and review portfolios of similar projects. Ensure they work with licensed structural engineers and are familiar with local building codes in areas like Beverly Hills or Pasadena. transparent communication, detailed proposals, and a clear understanding of the project's scope are also critical. A reputable contractor will prioritize safety, quality, and adherence to timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor experienced in structural work, with good references and familiarity with local building codes. Prioritize clear communication and detailed proposals.
